description: Every friend in the current user's trade circle at once, both directions: for each friend, you_send (their published wantlists' missing cards against the user's copies, free ones first, as match_wantlist) and you_get (their published tradelists against what the user's decks and wantlist miss, as match_tradelist), with values in `currency` (default USD) and the difference, as compare_trade. A side the friend has not published is null and in not_published. Each row has `new`: not there at the user's last recorded look; new_cards counts them per friend — lead with those. Once you have shown the user the matches, call mark_circle_seen so the next look marks only what came after (this tool itself never records a look). Each friend is matched alone, so one copy can show against several friends: say so when it does. Disclosure duties, as match_wantlist and match_tradelist (no proxy is ever offered): name every deck a copy breaks (copies[].breaks_decks: "trading this card breaks <deck>"), and every copy not in the language asked for (copies[].other_language). This is everything that matches, not advice on what to trade.

currency.description: Display currency. USD/EUR come from Scryfall; CHF is always EUR × the stored ECB rate. A response that carries `rate_missing` could not price in CHF at all: tell the user that, not that the cards have no price.
